articles.headline: Caribbean Football Union endorses Infantino ahead of FIFA presidential election
articles.description: The Caribbean Football Union has endorsed Gianni Infantino following regional consultations, boosting his bid ahead of the FIFA presidential March election.

articles.headline: FIFA's chief legal officer steps down in second high-profile exit
articles.description: Emilio García Silvero, who has served as FIFA's chief legal and compliance officer for the past eight years, is stepping down from his position.
